The 7.5 worker explicitly recorded as a known limitation that it did not re-run the live host end-to-end install/load/render verification and that the 7.8 live run was against the 568,004-byte package. The consolidated record documents P1 (no byte-identity test), P2 (reduced debug metadata), and V6 (host-guarded skips), but not this residual: the current shipped artifact has not itself been exercised live end-to-end. The gap is low risk because no product code changed (debug metadata and zip layout only), the host-guarded suite exercises the pinned host in-process on the final artifact (1234/44/1278), and the 7.8 live run demonstrated the pipeline on a functionally equivalent package. It is not an overclaim of a capability, but as the canonical limitations record it would be more complete with a verification-coverage note.
